description: Boot-smoke milestone baselines. Owner decision 22 (2026-09-18) replaced the self-tracking `190 + 2 x transport sectors` menu identity with two independent numbers: an absolute ceiling that states the owner's real budget, and a delta against the baseline below. The 2026-09-20 re-basing applies the same shape to the `loader` milestone, which until then was gated only by accident through a hard-coded frame-300 observation point in the boot smoke. Re-record `baseline` deliberately, in the same commit as the change that grows the transport on purpose, and state the reason in the commit message.

recorded.runtime_checkpoint: docs/diagnostics/hardware-boot.md: F1 (stage 2 arms DSTATS before every SIOV call) and real SIO (-nopatch) in every cold boot-smoke session, owner answers Q1-Q2
recorded.sio_mode: real SIO: Atari800 -nopatch, the OS SIOV at register level
recorded.reason: Re-recorded because the boot smoke now runs real SIO (owner answer Q2, 2026-10-09). The old baseline (339/596) measured the OS phase and stage 2 through Atari800's SIO patch, whose SIOV costs no wire time; under -nopatch the 107 OS-boot sectors and the 106 stage-2 sectors cost their wire time (3.7-3.8 frames a sector). MEASURED: atr-a5 loader 1094, menu 1351 (patch on, same build: 296 / 553, +798). Transport unchanged at 107 + 106 = 213 sectors; F1 is byte-neutral. The 3000-frame (60-s) absolute ceiling holds with 1649 frames to spare.
